result.description: Google's advertising platform; API manages Google Ads accounts, campaigns, ad groups, keywords, assets and reporting.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 only (scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords), user auth-code or service account. Developer tokens reportedly sunset 2026-09-09; access now gated by Cloud project access level (Test/Explorer/Basic/Standard).
result.access_detail: Cloud project starts with Test access (test accounts only). Explorer (2,880 ops/day, production accounts) via automated review in most cases; Basic needs brand verification; Standard needs manual review. Google Ads account needed to use it. Sensitive-scope OAuth app verification likely needed for public multi-user apps (not verified from page).
result.api_notes: Google Ads API callable via gRPC or REST; official client libraries (gRPC-based). Covers account, campaign, ad group, keyword, asset, conversion management and GAQL reporting (search/searchStream) across the full account hierarchy.
result.blocker: Access-level review: Explorer is automated but low-quota; Basic/Standard need brand verification/manual review for higher volume. Developer-token sunset claim (page dated after 2026-09) should be rechecked.

evidence.quote: You can build software that manages accounts from the customer level down to the keyword level.
Just like other Google APIs, Google Ads API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization.
Developer tokens were sunset on September 9, 2026.
After you've enabled Google Ads API, your Google Cloud project is granted Test access.
Completing brand verification for your Google Cloud project is a prerequisite to apply for Basic access level.
If you need Standard access, you need a manual review.
The Google Ads API can be called either using gRPC or REST.
The Google Ads MCP Server exposes MCP Tools and MCP Resources backed by the Google Ads API.
